text:
maria-chen: Heads up — hetero CI smoke on node group 'h100-hetero-3' is red after a test-run that triggered a host soft-reset / power-cycle. Root cause looks like a kernel hang + gpu driver reporting invalid-device-function immediately after the node came back up. attaching quick logs below.

nate: thx, can you paste the dmesg around the time? did the node reboot or just GPU reset?

maria-chen: Node shows a soft reboot (systemd reported unit failures) but kubelet stayed up. dmesg snippet:
```
[Jun 14 12:01:42] pcieport 0000:01:00.0: AER: Corrected error received: id=00e0
[Jun 14 12:01:43] NVRM: GPU 0000:01:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[Jun 14 12:01:45] NVRM: GPU 0000:01:00.0: RmInitAdapter failed! (0x23:0xffff:872)
[Jun 14 12:01:46] nvidia: probe of 0000:01:00.0 failed with error -22
```

aj: error -22 = EINVAL; often driver/firmware mismatch or PCI link flapping. Any recent driver bump in the canary pool?

maria-chen: We rolled driver 535.105 -> 537.10 on that pool two nights ago (canary). Only this hetero job set hit it, majority of tests passed but this warmup + long-seq model triggered the issue.

katie: do we have nv-hostengine / SM logs? also, any ECC page faults?

maria-chen: nv-hostengine logs show a soft-reset attempt followed by a timeout waiting for device init. No explicit ECC fatal.

infra-ops-bot: rerun requested by @maria-chen: /rerun ci/hetero-smoke-h100-3 --node h100-hetero-3

nate: let's not rerun wide; can we repro on a single node? maria, can you ssh and run this quick check:
```bash
sudo modprobe -r nvidia_uvm nvidia_drm nvidia || true
sudo modprobe nvidia_drm nvidia_uvm nvidia
nvidia-smi -q | head -n 40
dmesg | tail -n 60 | sed -n '1,40p'
```

maria-chen: ran the sequence, nvidia-smi shows "Invalid Device Function" for gpu0, others OK. dmesg shows repeated pci errors and then: 
```
[Jun 14 12:10:01] NVRM: RmInitAdapter failed! (0x23:0xffff:872)
[Jun 14 12:10:05] NVRM: Xid (79): 0x0, 0x00000000, 0x00000000
```

aj: Xid 79 usually points to GPU reset timeout. Might be a PCI link/firmware regression with 537.10. Do we have ability to roll back driver on that node to 535.105 and see if gpu comes back?

maria-chen: rolling back now on one node to test. will report.

infra-ops: FYI we've seen similar transient invalid-device-function after firmware update on DGX in Q4 last year; suggested workaround was to power-cycle the entire server (not just soft reset) to clear PCI link state. Planning a cold power-cycle if rollback fails.

maria-chen: rollback done — driver back to 535.105, restarted kubelet pods. nvidia-smi now shows GPU present and warmup passes. hetero-smoke job requeued and passed on that node.

katie: good repro/rollback case — we should bisect driver release to confirm regression. can someone file a short bug with steps + attach dmesg and nv-hostengine logs?

nate: I'll open a tracker and request an L1->FW escalation if bisect points to firmware interactions. maria can you upload logs to the tracker: /var/log/nvidia-hostengine/* and dmesg output?

maria-chen: uploaded to the ticket (link in thread). notes: repro only with long-sequence generation (>1024 tokens) concurrent with concurrent KVCACHE usage; short runs don't fail.

aj: interesting — suggests sequence-length driven kernel path or memory layout exercise. Also add PCIe ASPM settings on the node to ticket.

infra-ops: plan: 1) rollback driver on remaining canary nodes, 2) schedule cold power-cycle for the original node during maintenance window, 3) bisect driver xfirmware with vendor. Will update SLA channel once scheduled.

maria-chen: thanks all. will follow up if anything else pops up in next 24h. :thumbsup:
